name: Biological and Biomedical Sciences (BBS)
tracks: Biochemistry, Quantitative Biology, Biophysics and Structural Biology
Molecular Cell Biology, Genetics, and Development
Translational Molecular Medicine, Pharmacology, and Physiology
summary: One application is the gateway to 12 Yale PhD programs. Apply to one of nine Tracks; first-year students rotate in labs and select a thesis lab at the end of the first year.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The Graduate School lists December 1, 2026 and states that all application deadlines are 11:59 pm Eastern.

timeline.decisions: Applicants are notified in February–March 2027. The reply deadline for most Fall 2027 offers is April 15, 2027.

english.note: TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic is required for most non-native English speakers. Exempt with an undergraduate degree taught in English and at least three years in residence. Test no later than November and within 24 months of applying. Incoming doctoral students below Yale’s teaching Speaking threshold must attend the August Summer English Language program; these teaching thresholds are not admission minimums.

applicationFee.note: US citizens, permanent residents and non-US citizens may request a waiver for documented financial hardship or qualifying program participation/status. Submit a separate request well before the application deadline; processing usually takes 2 to 3 business days.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from every college attended
requirements.note: Select the BBS Track matching your research interests. Plant Molecular Biology applicants are strongly encouraged to contact a primary faculty member before applying.

funding.note: The Graduate School states that every PhD student receives full tuition, a living stipend and paid health coverage. Full funding normally extends for at least five years. No Fall 2027 stipend amount is stated on the opened replacement pages.
